absent: Reader thread loop, warm cool helpers, duration aggregation, and scale operation table beyond names matched in init.
Tiny SRCU read lock, callback enqueue, boot list linkage, and workqueue interaction details.
Tree SRCU field layout, node tree, grace period and expedited state machines, and flavor specific read paths.
RCU tree and tiny control block layouts, sequence helpers, and normal versus expedited wakeup mechanics.
Torture, scheduler, IRQ, completion, and wait queue primitives owned by other dossiers.

findings.text: Initialization selects a scale implementation by matching a configured name against a table of candidates, rejects unknown names, runs optional type specific setup, records parameters, optionally arms shutdown, normalizes reader and loop counts with warnings, allocates reader records, creates reader threads and a coordinator thread, and unwinds through common cleanup on failure.

Coordinator pins placement and lowers priority, allocates per run averages and output buffer, optionally delays, waits until all readers signal ready, then per experiment resets readers, publishes run index and start indications and wakes each reader queue, waits for run completion, stores average cost per iteration, warms and cools around the series, prints tabulated averages in bounded chunks, optionally powers off via cleanup, and otherwise blocks until told to stop before freeing resources.

Cleanup guards against concurrent cleanup, returns early when no implementation is selected, stops each reader thread, releases reader storage, stops the coordinator thread, invokes optional implementation specific teardown, and closes the cleanup window.
Parameter reporter emits current scale name and tuning values for verbosity, shutdown, delays, instance counts, loops, readers, runs and read delay.

Tiny SRCU instance setup zeroes two nesting counters, prepares a wait queue, empties the callback queue with tail pointing at head, clears grace period running and waiting flags, zeroes index and maximum index, and prepares deferred work and interrupt work items bound to grace period driving.

Tiny read unlock runs with preemption held, decrements the nesting count for the given index, restores preemption, and when the count reaches zero while a grace period waits and context permits sleeping wakeup, wakes one waiter.

Tiny grace period worker exits if already running or no index work is pending, otherwise marks running, detaches pending callbacks under interrupt protection, advances the index once and arms waiting, releases protection while polling with bounded sleeps until the old index has no readers, then clears waiting and advances the index again, invokes detached callbacks with bottom half protection, clears running, and requeues itself when further index work arrived.
Tiny interrupt work handler recovers the owning SRCU instance from the work item and schedules its grace period work.

Scheduler start marker records running state in a widely visible integer, and boot SRCU setup marks initialization done then drains a boot list by unlinking each queued instance and scheduling its grace period work.
Default expedited holdoff is twenty five thousand and backs the mutable holdoff control, while wrap check threshold is the maximum unsigned long shifted right by two.
Sizing selectors are none zero, init one, torture two, auto three, contend sixteen, with combined tests for selected mode and for none, and the sizing control defaults to auto.
Size thresholds are one hundred twenty eight CPUs for big and one hundred contentions for small, node init sequence is two, and log prefix is rcu followed by colon space.

Tree SRCU constructors record a reader flavor of normal, fast, or fast updown before shared common setup that validates no locks are held on the object, initializes lock dependency state, and initializes fields in non sleepable context, with a generic variant that defaults to normal flavor. A separate tree flag records whether SRCU initialization has completed.

Reader presence on an index is judged by summing per CPU lock counts and comparing against summed unlock counts gathered first, tracking observed reader flavors and warning on mixed flavors, treating slow grace readers as requiring grace period assistance, and otherwise inserting either a full memory barrier or an RCU synchronization before the lock sum, so equality implies an instant with no readers on that index subject to documented late increment bounds.

Tiny synchronize waits outside read sections by disabling preemption around a two step advance of the control block sequence. Tree synchronize warns on use inside read sections, delegates to expedited or normal paths when blocking is allowed, and otherwise performs an early boot vacuous grace period by opening and closing a polled snapshot and advancing global and node sequences under interrupt protection while asserting single CPU operation.

Normal synchronize path traces a request, takes a fast wait when wakeups are disabled or latched, otherwise prepares a completion and optional state snapshot, enqueues a request, kicks polling and waits for completion before tracing completion. Polled start begins the polled sequence when idle and snapshots it; polled end completes it only when the snapshot still matches and clears related snapshots, otherwise zeroes the caller snapshot.

Root node protection for polled snapshots is conditional on initialization having published online CPUs, with interrupt saving acquisition around the critical section and a held lock assertion inside once the scheduler is no longer inactive.

Hazards include calling synchronize while holding read side state, negative or excessive reader loop and run counts with overflow of their product requiring clamping to at least one, out of memory for coordinator buffers, mixed reader flavors on one instance, and lost wakeups in tiny unlock requiring polling with timeout.
